description: Access Dune queries and analytics results for blockchain research. Use query results as inputs to research on on-chain activity. Define the network, time window, and metric before collecting results, then organize the output into comparable datasets. Network selection, data freshness, and query conditions affect the meaning of a result. Retain these conditions with the analysis and avoid comparing statistics that cover different populations or time ranges without adjustment.
description_cn: 访问 Dune 查询和分析结果，辅助区块链数据研究。适合围绕链上活动准备分析数据和研究资料。可先明确查询范围、时间窗口及指标定义，再将返回结果整理为可比较的数据集。区块链网络、数据更新时点和查询条件会影响结果口径，解释结论时应保留这些条件，避免把不同范围的统计结果直接比较。
